messages:
mia (customer-success): Hey @eng-team — customer hit 422 on POST /v1/rerank. They sent a payload that mixes documents + candidates and some nested fields named 'query'. Can someone triage?
noah (eng): Can you paste the exact payload and the full error text?
mia (customer-success): Paste below. Received 422 with validation errors. curl copy:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{
    "query": {"text": "best italian restaurants"},
    "documents": [
      {"id": "d1", "text": "Trattoria X", "passages": [{"text":"pasta", "query": "mistaken"}]},
      {"id": "d2", "text": "Pizzeria Y"}
    ],
    "candidates": [
      {"id": "c1", "text": "Trattoria X - menu"}
    ]
  }'
```
mia (customer-success): Error body: "ValidationError: Ambiguous payload: found both top-level 'candidates' and 'documents'; nested key 'query' present in documents[0].passages[0] which collides with root query"
olivia (support): That nested 'query' inside a passage is the smoking gun. Our validator treats any nested key named 'query' as a potential query override and flags collisions when root query + docs/candidates mix exist.
sam (eng-ml): Repro notes for eng: if payload contains both 'documents' and 'candidates' we currently assume exclusive modes. If additionally a nested object contains a top-level param name (like 'query'), the schema walker resolves ambiguous paths and raises a 422.
noah (eng): Minimal repro for local: use the curl above, or run the unit harness: 
- POST payload 
- watch server log: ValidationError: payload.query collision with documents[0].passages[0].query
- observed behaviour: scores returned are all 0.0 when validation is bypassed.
mia (customer-success): Customer expectation: they thought 'candidates' are an optional shortlist and can coexist with 'documents' for richer metadata. They want graceful fallback, not an opaque 422.
sam (eng-ml): Short-term suggestion: 1) reply with workaround: remove nested 'query' keys from passages or rename them, and move candidates into documents with a flag (e.g., metadata.candidate=true) OR only send candidates OR only send documents. 2) We'll improve error message to explain the collision and point to the offending path.
noah (eng): I'll open an internal ticket with test-case and logs. Creating RERANK-3421 and attaching this thread. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml.
deploy-bot: New issue RERANK-3421 created by noah (link: https://redwood.internal/issues/RERANK-3421)
mia (customer-success): Thanks — I'll send the workaround to the customer and ask if they want an official feature (allow_mixed_candidates_docs).
olivia (support): Please include a short repro snippet and recommended schema shape in that reply. I'll draft the message. :thumbsup:
sam (eng-ml): Follow-up: I'll also add a client-side input linter rule that warns when payload contains both candidates+documents or nested keys that shadow root params. Server-side we can change validator to emit a detailed error pointing to the exact JSON path.
noah (eng): Assigned RERANK-3421 to sam. Keep me posted if customer pushes for product change.
mia (customer-success): closing loop here — thanks everyone.
